# ax-claude-config-public

A curated, sanitized public mirror of [@xingfanxia](https://github.com/xingfanxia)'s working `~/.claude` Claude Code config.

> **Read this first.** This is a **portfolio + reference**, not a turnkey install. Many skills depend on plugins, MCP servers, environment variables, or local infrastructure that aren't bundled here. Treat this as a starting point and reference for your own setup. See [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md) for required external pieces.

## What's here

- `skills/` — ~50 custom skills covering content writing (卡兹克 / 晚点 / WeChat styles), design (Huashu, frontend, design-md), engineering workflow (big-task, audit-fix-loop, codebase-sweep, plan-design-review), divination (banxian-skill), pet generation (pet-forge), jewelry marketing, image gen (gpt-image, gemini-image, nanobanana), and more.
- `agents/` — ~50 custom subagent definitions (code-reviewer, security-reviewer, planner, debug-session-manager, GSD ecosystem, etc.)
- `commands/` — ~40 slash commands (/big-task, /publish-public, /sync, /investigate, /ship, /verify, etc.)
- `hooks/` — automation hooks (Stop, PreToolUse) for prompt guards, context monitoring, neat-freak reminders
- `rules/` — engineering and workflow standards (`engineering.md`, `workflow.md`)
- `CLAUDE.md` — global instructions
- `INDEX.md` — auto-generated TOC of every asset (regenerated on each sync)

## How this is maintained

Changes flow private → public via `~/.claude/scripts/sync-public.sh` with a fail-closed two-tier audit (Tier 1: identity-term grep; Tier 2: gitleaks). The public repo is a **one-way mirror** — edits made directly here will be clobbered on the next sync.

Workflow lives in `commands/publish-public.md` (the `/publish-public` slash command in Claude Code).
